meta.cell: 0.05 deg GloFAS cell centred 4.275 S 104.375 E, the cell the weir point falls in; neighbours tested: 4.225 S 104.375 E mean 215.4, 4.275 S 104.325 E mean 211.7, 4.325 S 104.325 E (Martapura gauge cell) mean 207.8, 4.325 S 104.375 E mean 2.5 (a side stream, rejected); all main-river cells within 4 percent of each other

meta.caveat: Modelled reanalysis, not a measurement: GloFAS v4 is a global hydrological model (LISFLOOD on a 0.05 deg grid) driven by ERA5 weather. It does not know Bendung Perjaya, its gates, the Komering canal intakes or Danau Ranau's outlet control, and it is not calibrated to any public Komering gauge. Open-Meteo serves this point only from 1997-01-01 (1984-1996 returned empty), so no values before 1997 are given. The mean (about 214 m3/s) is about 9 percent below the JICA 2003 simulated natural annual mean for Komering 1 (235.9 m3/s, 4,527 km2). Dry-season low flows are far too low: the model falls to about 2 m3/s in droughts, while JICA gives a 10-year 355th-day flow of 23.0 m3/s and the irrigation project keeps 35 m3/s as river maintenance flow; do not use the low tail for design. 2026 is a part year and not in the flood fit.

flood_frequency.fit: method of moments on annual maxima of complete years 1997-2025 (n=29), K_T = -(sqrt6/pi)(0.5772+ln ln(T/(T-1)))
